_comment: What the golden set SUBMITS. The yardstick — what must come back — lives next door in expected/expectations.json, deliberately in a separate file: a capture's material is an input the instrument replays unchanged, while an expectation is the thing that must never be quietly edited to make a run pass. Keeping them apart makes an edit to either one visible for what it is in a diff.
_order: Processed in listed order, one at a time, and the order is load-bearing exactly once: F04 is byte-identical to F01 and can only be REJECTED as a duplicate after F01 has actually filed. Everything else is order-independent.
_materials: Every material is clean synthetic prose about invented organizations. No DOUBLE: directives appear anywhere in this set — those steer the offline double and would make the golden measure the fixture instead of the backend. The keyless sensitivity tests own their own directive-carrying material.

captures._material_note: Points at F01's file ON PURPOSE. The dedup levels key on the payload's own sha256, so 'the same material' has to be the same BYTES — a second file kept in sync by hand would silently stop being a duplicate the first time somebody fixed a typo in one of them.
captures._submitter_note: A DIFFERENT submitter from F01, and that is what makes this case reach `rejected` at all: level 1 (retry collapse) is scoped to the same submitter within the dedup window and would answer `filed_retry` instead, which is a different — and correct — outcome for a person double-tapping their own submit.
